# TrueFix Labs

> Trading Engineering Knowledge Base and Open Source Trading Infrastructure Portal.

## Primary topics
- Trading system architecture
- Rust trading systems
- Multi-broker and multi-venue design
- Broker and exchange APIs
- Market data and instrument identity
- OMS, execution, risk, idempotency, and reconciliation
- FIX, REST, and WebSocket architecture
- AI trading agents, permissions, human approval, and audit

## Evidence policy
Technical claims should link to primary provider documentation, standards, source code, or reproducible examples. Provider capabilities can vary by region, account, product, environment, and entitlement.
